do: speak the client's words: no commands, flags, exit codes, table or field names
example: not "source: <tool> compute kpi (exit 0)"; instead "ads data up to Mar 14"

do: one line per data group with its as-of date and status
example: Sales data up to Mar 13 (4 days behind): stale

do: only facts that help me decide; no metaphors or reasoning
example: Ads figures: Feb 13 to Mar 14. not "ads are like a shop door…"

when: a page has something waiting for my decision
example: the competitors page starts with "waiting for your score"

when: editing a list or making a choice
do: lists as chips (× to remove, add only from the suggested list); choices as buttons or selects
use the client's own word for it, everywhere
example: the word the client used in the first meeting

do: the reason is optional; left empty, it is filled with a default
the same top navigation, current page marked; usable on a phone
the client's language by default, with a switch the browser remembers

when: naming a page, column, button or status
do: use the name similar tools use most; one name per thing across the site; names the owner set change only by the owner
